title: WE HEARD SHE LOVES BARBIE
beats: COLD OPEN (face at 0s): the girl hugging the pink bear she chose, mother smiling beside her - flash-forward to her peak before the story starts
the start: "We heard you love Barbie" -> the box on her lap -> "Do you love it?" "Thank you." "Yes."
choosing from the bag: "This one?" "Is this the one you want?"
the pink bear is handed over and she pulls it in
Miss Israel comes over: "What's her name?" - she answers (name left uncaptioned: not verifiable)
Miss Israel hugs her, bear and all
CLOSE: Miss Israel takes the crown off her own head
WIDE (synced): she raises it and turns to the girl - angle change on the action

ENDING, wordless: crown on; the girl straightens it; her mother laughs behind her hand (76-79) - the payoff held, no caption. (The later footage shows the crown being handed back, so the film ends here.)
